description: This PHP source file defines a helper class '_parse_proppatch' for parsing PROPPATCH request bodies within a WebDAV server context. The class reads an XML-formatted request body from a file, processes XML elements and character data, and stores properties for further handling.

classes.name: _parse_proppatch
